notes: 0.19 One instrument. 3D is now the wheel seen with depth: the chart plane tilts in from the wheel, the orbit stays level (no roll, no flips), a 'level' chip and two-finger tap bring it back. Planar lenses (horizon, meridian, ecliptic, equator, prime vertical) are the spine: tap a plane, tap a side to isolate a hemisphere, quadrant (houses 10-12, 7-9, 1-3, 4-6) or octant; the wheel and the 3D show the same isolation. Analemma: the 8 stays still while you scrub (horizon pinned); twist while holding the clock turns the clock hand. One entry/exit, one hint line, one stack of engraved lines; first-tap miss fixed.
